stem.text: An observer hears a sound wave emitted from a moving source.
The observed frequency is less than the frequency of sound emitted from the source.
What could be the reason for this?

A.text: The source is moving away from the observer.

B.text: The source is moving towards the observer.

C.text: The speed of the sound wave in air decreases due to the movement of the source.

D.text: The speed of the sound wave in air increases due to the movement of the source.
